values.binNote: Sheet has no explicit tick-interval field; RDuration=1.5 and 6 instances imply a 0.25s interval (1.5/6), consistent with the wiki's stated value but not directly named by any bin row.

values.quote: ''Infinite Duress'' deals a total of 6 damage instances
values.binNote: No bin row enumerates instance count; it is inferable from RDuration=1.5 divided by the 0.25s tick interval described in the wiki text, but the bin does not state either the interval or the count directly.

values.meaning: healing from post-mitigation damage dealt to target
values.quote: '''Warwick''' {{tip|heals}} for 100% of all {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and modifiers.}} he deals to the target during ''Infinite Duress''
values.binNote: This heal ratio is not present anywhere in the WarwickR sheet rows; it appears to be an undocumented (tooltip-only in the bin, or handled by a generic heal-on-damage effect not exposed as a DataValue/Calculation) mechanic.

mechanics.claim: Infinite Duress both applies on-hit effects and triggers on-attack effects 3 times over its duration.
mechanics.quote: ''Infinite Duress'' both applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects 3 times over its duration.

mechanics.claim: The 1st, 3rd, and 5th ticks deal 2/9ths of total damage as a single instance while applying both spell and on-hit effects and triggering on-attack effects; the 2nd, 4th, 6th ticks deal 1/9th while applying spell effects only.
mechanics.quote: The 1st, 3rd, and 5th ticks deals 2/9ths of the total damage as a single instance while applying both spell and on-hit effects, and triggering on-attack effects.

mechanics.claim: If cleansed, Warwick continues to strike but deals no damage during the channel.
mechanics.quote: Cleansing the suppression does not interrupt the channel and Warwick will continue to strike but not deal any damage.

mechanics.claim: If the target is crowd control immune or spell-shielded on collision, Warwick will not start the channel and deals no damage.
mechanics.quote: If the target is crowd control immune or protected by spell shield upon collision, '''Warwick''' will not start the channel.

mechanics.claim: Warwick can cast Primal Howl during the dash and channel.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Primal Howl|Warwick}} can be cast during the dash.''
